ac74bd4d88c39f1cf7243d2ead04c72ca6f2823d.caption: Don't example: a white popover with the text "Select max. 3 different products" opened from the info button of a combobox with the label "Product Name". The popover covers most of the input, leaving only its clear button visible at the right edge, and a pointer cursor sits inside the popover. This is wrong because required information such as the selection limit is hidden behind the info button instead of being shown as a hint.

c980e4db70db6b44ce1678b009af44df9b654e2f.caption: Do example with three callouts. Callout 1 points at the horizontal radio group "Form of address" with the options "Mr." (selected), "Mrs." and "other", used for fewer than 5 items. Callout 2 points at the "Options" combobox with the placeholder "Select" and a chevron, opened to a list with "Label", "Label", "Option 3" and "Label" (5 to 20 items, opens on click). Callout 3 points at the "Country" combobox with typed input "B|" and a clear button, showing a filtered list of "Label", "Label", "Bangladesh", "Label" and "Label" (more than 20 items, opens after typing).

d2c0be31c1dd48a41f999bc488cbf10ab00e416d.caption: Do example: a form with the heading "Legend", a radio group with the legend "Radio Group Legend" and two "Radio Label" options, followed by a "Select" field with a chevron and several "Label" text inputs, laid over a 12-column grid. All fields stay within the left 8 columns, at most two fields share a row (a short and a long field, or a long and a short one), and the right 4 columns remain empty.
